name: Identify the cross-section of a prism
description: Student can identify the cross-section of a right prism.
exampleOfSuccess: The student says a triangular prism has a triangular cross-section.
commonError: Student names a face that is not the constant cross-section.
checkpointTask: Show prisms. Ask the student to identify the cross-section of each.

name: Recognise a constant cross-section
description: Student can recognise that a right prism has the same cross-section along its length.
exampleOfSuccess: The student says slicing a cylinder gives the same circle each time.
commonError: Student thinks the cross-section changes along the object.
checkpointTask: Show objects. Ask the student which have a constant cross-section.

name: Relate a cross-section to a prism
description: Student can relate a given cross-section to the right prism it forms.
exampleOfSuccess: The student says a hexagonal cross-section forms a hexagonal prism.
commonError: Student cannot link the cross-section shape to the prism name.
checkpointTask: Show cross-sections. Ask the student to name the prism each forms.

name: Draw the cross-section of an object
description: Student can draw the shape resulting from slicing an object.
exampleOfSuccess: The student draws the rectangle made by slicing a rectangular prism.
commonError: Student draws a face rather than the cross-section from the slice.
checkpointTask: Show an object and a slice. Ask the student to draw the resulting cross-section.

name: Plot a point in the four quadrants
description: Student can plot a point in any of the four quadrants of the Cartesian plane.
exampleOfSuccess: The student plots (minus 3, 2) in the second quadrant.
commonError: Student ignores the signs and plots in the first quadrant.
checkpointTask: Give coordinates with positive and negative values. Ask the student to plot each.

name: Read coordinates in the four quadrants
description: Student can read the coordinates of a point in any quadrant.
exampleOfSuccess: The student reads a point in the third quadrant as (minus 2, minus 4).
commonError: Student gives the coordinates in the wrong order or with the wrong signs.
checkpointTask: Mark points in different quadrants. Ask the student to read the coordinates.

name: Describe how coordinates change with movement
description: Student can describe how the coordinates change when a point is moved.
exampleOfSuccess: The student says moving a point 3 left decreases the first coordinate by 3.
commonError: Student changes the wrong coordinate, or the wrong direction.
checkpointTask: Move a point on the plane. Ask the student to describe the change in coordinates.

name: Draw a polygon from coordinates
description: Student can plot a set of coordinates and join them to draw a polygon.
exampleOfSuccess: The student plots four points and joins them to draw a rectangle.
commonError: Student plots points incorrectly so the polygon is wrong.
checkpointTask: Give a list of coordinates. Ask the student to plot and join them.

name: Identify transformations in a tessellation
description: Student can identify the transformations used in a tessellating pattern.
exampleOfSuccess: The student says a pattern uses reflections and translations.
commonError: Student names transformations not present, or misses one.
checkpointTask: Show tessellating patterns. Ask the student which transformations each uses.

name: Create a tessellation
description: Student can create a tessellating pattern using a shape.
exampleOfSuccess: The student tessellates a shape with no gaps or overlaps.
commonError: Student leaves gaps or overlaps the shapes.
checkpointTask: Give a shape. Ask the student to create a tessellation with it.

name: Use combinations of transformations
description: Student can use combinations of transformations to make a pattern.
exampleOfSuccess: The student combines a rotation and a translation to make a pattern.
commonError: Student uses a single transformation, or applies them inconsistently.
checkpointTask: Ask the student to make a pattern using two or more transformations.

name: Design a pattern or logo with transformations
description: Student can design a geometric pattern or logo using transformations.
exampleOfSuccess: The student designs a logo by reflecting and rotating one shape.
commonError: Student arranges shapes without using transformations.
checkpointTask: Ask the student to design a pattern or logo using transformations of one shape.
